readings.summary: With SuppressSourceGeneration=true, the analyzer must continue reporting all applicable MsgPack0xx diagnostics except the deliberately omitted generation-only MsgPack011, MsgPack016, and MsgPack017, while emitting no generated source.
readings.code_difference: Analyzer diagnostics must not be disabled together with source generation; code violating non-generation rules is diagnosed as in 3.1.0, generation-only diagnostics remain suppressed, generated formatters remain absent, and behavior with the property unset or false is unchanged.
